jobs.description:
Junior Full Stack Engineer

Location: Bengaluru

Employment type: Full-time

Experience level: 1-2 years


About the role

You’ll work across the stack TypeScript, React, and Python - shipping real features with

mentorship from experienced engineers.

This is an in-office role. You will need to come to our office in HSR Layout, Bengaluru on

working days.

This role is designed for someone early in their career who learns quickly, communicates

clearly, and wants ownership that grows with skill. You don’t need to know everything on day

one. Curiosity, solid fundamentals, and a habit of asking good questions matter more than a

long tool checklist.


What you'll do
  • Build and ship user-facing features in React and TypeScript, with guidance on design and code quality
  • Contribute to Python APIs and services that power Hunar Connect, including REST endpoints and basic data access with SQL
  • Work from well-scoped tickets: clarify requirements, propose a simple approach, implement, and open pull requests for review
  • Write clear, maintainable code and add basic tests where they protect important behavior
  • Debug issues across the frontend, API, and database with help from teammates when you’re stuck
  • Participate in code review - both receiving feedback and, over time, giving thoughtful review to peers
  • Collaborate with product and design to understand the “why” behind features, not only the “what”
  • Improve docs, small tooling, or developer experience when you spot friction (with support)


Requirements (must-haves)
  • 0–2 years of professional software experience, or equivalent through internships, bootcamps, coursework, open source, or substantial personal projects
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript and JavaScript
  • Experience building UIs with React (or a similar modern UI framework)
  • Familiarity with Node.js and building or consuming REST APIs
  • Basic SQL skills (reading queries, simple joins, understanding tables and relationships)
  • Comfort with Git (branching, commits, pull requests)
  • Ability to break a problem into steps, communicate progress, and ask for help early
  • Willingness to learn in public: take feedback, iterate, and document what you learn


Nice-to-haves
  • Exposure to testing (unit or integration) in a JS/TS codebase
  • Familiarity with cloud basics, CI/CD, or deploying a small app end-to-end
  • Experience with relational databases beyond simple queries (indexes, migrations)
  • Interest in accessibility, performance, or product analytics
  • Contributions to open source, hackathons, or teaching/mentoring others

None of these are required. They’re signals of curiosity, not filters.


How to apply

Apply via https://apply.hunar.ai/job/nRWg3SAV?utm=jq_ot
